hook.text: Marketing says there are 50K customers. Sales says 48K. Same company, different numbers.

buildup.text: The mismatch happens when each team defines 'customer' differently in their own data mart.

discovery.text: A conformed dimension is a shared, agreed-upon definition used identically across all marts.

twist.text: Building conformed dimensions requires cross-team agreement — the hardest part is politics, not code.

climax.text: Conformed dimensions let you compare facts across departments with confidence in the numbers.

punchline.text: Same word, same meaning, everywhere. That's conformity.

quiz.question: What problem do conformed dimensions solve?
options: Inconsistent definitions of shared entities across teams
